Subject: Inquiry: GCP Marketplace procurement & co-sell requirements

Hi Sean,

Quick intro — I run procurement for Gateway Health. We're evaluating Redwood for a number of internal projects and our procurement/legal teams asked whether we can purchase via the GCP Marketplace (so licensing flows through GCP invoicing) and whether Redwood participates in co-sell programs with Google.

Specific asks from our side:
- Can you confirm whether Redwood supports GCP Marketplace private pricing (listed + negotiated pricing) and whether you can accept order/commitment via the marketplace SKUs?
- If yes, what is the procurement workflow you expect on our side (PO vs DocuSign, who signs, billing contact, lead times)?
- Any required documentation: SOC2, data processing addendum, reseller agreements?

We're targeting an internal approval decision by the week of Feb 22. Can we set a short call to align on the onboarding steps and share a draft PO template?

Thanks,

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 09:20:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Inquiry: GCP Marketplace procurement & co-sell requirements

Tara — thanks for the note and the clear asks. Happy to help and we can absolutely support GCP Marketplace purchases; we also have co-sell alignment in place for qualified deals.

High-level answers now, call suggested below for the details: 
- Marketplace procurement: Supported. We publish a listing and can create private SKUs for negotiated pricing. Billing can flow via GCP invoice and Gateway can submit PO to GCP per your internal process.
- Signature/workflow: For Marketplace transactions typically Google handles invoicing and we have a reseller/publisher agreement in place with Google. For direct enterprise contracts (Large Reserved/Dedicated) we use DocuSign and Redwood signs. If you want committed monthly spend on Dedicated, we'll need an MSA + SOW.
- Required docs: SOC 2 Type II report, DPA, ISO summary (if needed). We can provide a security packet and the GCP listing compliance checklist.

I can host a 30-min sync next week to walk the team through the onboarding checklist and share the SKU mapping we use for billing. Are you available Tue Feb 16 or Wed Feb 17 afternoon ET?

I've cc'd Marissa (billing & partner ops) to help with the SKU mapping and onboarding artifacts.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Action items:
- Marissa: please confirm whether we can create private SKUs for negotiated price and prepare a CSV mapping (internal SKU -> GCP SKU -> Redwood product name). See attached stub GCP_SKU_Mapping.csv.
- Jonas: can you confirm the lead time for Marketplace publisher changes (listing update, private SKU creation) and whether we need any publisher-level paperwork? If there are publisher onboarding tasks that require engineering (image/manifest updates) flag them.
- Aisha: please prepare a streamlined packet for procurement: SOC2 link, DPA template, one-page billing flow for marketplace purchases. We should include a sample PO template that they can fill out.

Notes for the packet: we should explicitly call out two procurement paths:
  1) Standard Marketplace purchase (customer subscribes via marketplace; GCP invoices and remits to Redwood) — fastest, minimal paperwork.
  2) Committed/Dedicated purchase (Reserved capacity) — requires Redwood MSA + SOW; can be wrapped through marketplace but we often execute direct enterprise agreements for custom terms.
